scope: Full features, complete frequency-ordered prefix join and exact overlap verification from existing staging implementation. Deduplicate raw-identical facets with all source mappings. Per-job CPU/disk/time bounds, no LSH/sample/truncation fallback or reset of old jobs; original state immutable. Parent independently checks wall/free/work every2seconds; SQLite temp path under owned scratch, filesystem free guard includes unlinked temporary files but retained-path work counter may not. No hardRSS sandbox. Component overlay must consume inherited exact+containment roots after full terminal evidence and audit.
